description: Expose a Windows SSH agent backend through a native AF_UNIX socket
notes: Requires Windows 10 version 1803 or later and GnuPG gpg-agent.
Add 'enable-ssh-support' and 'enable-putty-support' to gpg-agent.conf, then restart gpg-agent.
Run 'afunix-agent start' to start the daemon.
Set the socket for the current PowerShell session: $env:SSH_AUTH_SOCK = afunix-agent socket
